notes.title: Prodigy Tactics update #5 | 9 August 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28616363/11cfafac4c42be830c310eabf39309276c4b24d5.png[/img]

Hi everyone!
The newest patch for Prodigy Tactics is now live on Steam - make sure your game is up to date in order to play!
[b]
PATCH NOTE[/b]
[list]
[*] Ranked mode.
[*]New available character: Maëlis with skills + passive skill tree and passive information during the Maëlis Turn begin phase.
[*]You can now click anywhere during a tutorial to speed up pop-ups.
[*]End of turn: Harmony and Dissonance square(s) creation now happens simultaneously.
[*]Bastion: all enemy spawn at the same time with a shorter delay.
[*]End of combat: you can now click anywhere on the screen to accelerate the apparition of the victory/defeat screen and the battle results screen.
[*]Team select: before the battle screen, you can now click on a character to add it to your team (the character now appears in the first place available on the board).
[*]During combat, earned experience points appear when an enemy is killed.
[*]Minor bug fixes for your convenience.
[/list]

See you soon prodigies!
FE BluNectarine

notes.title: 'Quality of life' update is now live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28616363/0887e73298b22098481b323e19390861f818f9c5.png[/img]

Hi everyone!
May I present you the newest update that is now live on Steam - we've implemented fixes to make the game less buggy and more convenient. But it's not all - we are working on something bigger in January!

PATCH NOTE

FE BluNectarine

notes.title: Prodigy Tactics update #4 | 20 June 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28616363/338dd3f9b614337d48d35979410bd24fd18d246c.png[/img]

[b]Single Player Campaign. New arenas and enemies. Skill tree system.[/b]

The wait is over! Prodigy Tactics Update #4 is now LIVE!
It brings to the battlefield entirely new Single player campaign - we are happy to present you [b]the finished Elae Story Mode![/b] Join Elae in her quest and find out what are the motives and the backstory of Prodigy Tactics main characters. Hop into the airship and travel through Thasys to discover it's wonders!

This update, among few tweaks and fixes, also brings a brand new Leveling and Skill Tree system, to customize your team of Prodigies!
Below is the list of main changes and additions to the game, [b]on Steam Store page you can read the full update note.[/b]

[b]UPDATE[/b]
[list][*]Additional introduction Lesson in Tutorial
[*]Addition of the single player mode: Story
[*]Addition of the Skill Tree and leveling system
[*]New elements in Multiplayer Modes Against a Friend and Unranked battles
[*]Addition of 2 new arenas
[*]Camera adjustments
[*]Additional SFX and VFX
[*]No more poison stacking[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28616363/07aa5d4d7d3937d06508e4a5ebcbdc54b81825e4.jpg[/img]

The biggest update in Prodigy Tactics is just around the corner! We already know the update release date - [b]June 20th!![/b] Not long from now, you will be able to discover the story of the world torn by creatures fighting for last scraps of the life-giving force - mana. Join the adventure with Elae and her companions in the singleplayer Campaign, learn about the origins of Thasys and motives driving main characters!

To celebrate the announcement of a release date, we've prepared for you Prodigy Tactics key giveaway! [url=https://www.facebook.com/ForeverEntert/]Like us on Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/145774985529287/posts/1481007065339399/]share and comment this post[/url] for a chance to grab 1 of 10 free game keys on Steam! Join the adventure with Elae or battle your friends in a refreshed multiplayer mode - [b]Prodigy Tactics update COMING JUNE 20TH!![/b]

Winners will receive their game keys on June 20th via DM on Facebook!

notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/6weWNhILKO37DBeTPL/giphy.gif[/img]

Hi everyone!
I'm more than happy to show you the next reveal for the upcoming BIG update! Today I will share with you the most requested feature: the singleplayer mode. Are you excited? We sure are!
(click on screenshots -> "show image" to see them in full resolution)


The next update will bring you the ability to explore the world of Thasys and to discover its wonders. You will be able to travel freely by the airship.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28616363/cb9eb0bc1200ddcc1ed4e80f76dee5436ef702d7.jpg[/img]


Go on an adventure and do mini-quests!

notes.title: EA Update #4 reveal - part 1/3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28616363/cad0a99a6490d2c53bc702d6c9253e731125d07d.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!
Next update is just around the corner and it's time to share with you more of an in-depth reveal.
Today we'll start with entirely new feature, which brings RPG elements to the battlefield - [b]characters' development and customization![/b]
(click on the screenshots -> "show image" to see them in full resolutions)


Each character, while battling opponents, gain experience - the Crystal Mana, which allows them to level up.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28616363/7bea30ad6ba41a8c1979958ce566af478a8bb3df.jpg[/img]


You may use Crystal Mana (pool shared among every character) to level up chosen Hero in your character's screen. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28616363/d7cd1535c40357635927cb2444408bc4d72f2009.jpg[/img]


With every level up, your characters gain access to the Skill Tree. Every level gives you 2 Evolution Points, which can be further invested to modify statistics. Your progress will be saved automatically, and soon will be able in the multiplayer mode!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28616363/ec0c4c11133f448aa2404c1672d381c32b5a8dcc.jpg[/img]


Thasys is ruled by two powerful forces - Harmony and Dissonance. It reflects in two paths you may choose to follow.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28616363/5d3ffb034b00240ea1ca00b2f5c8f5b27624206e.jpg[/img]

------------------------------

Let us know what you think of those new RPG elements and stay tuned for the part 2 of this reveal that is coming soon!

Visit us on Steam forums, to share your ideas and suggestions: https://steamcommunity.com/app/626550/discussions/

notes.title: Prodigy Tactics update #3 | 24 January 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o751ZN7dCnNyXY3zG/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]New character and additional tutorial lessons. Introduction of new mechanics.[/b]

Another big update is now live! This month we decided to add new tutorial lessons to cover mechanics that were the most troublesome for new players, as well as updating the existing lessons with the new mechanics we introduce in this patch. Below is the list of main changes and additions to the game, on Steam Store page you can read full update note.

Next update will be up a bit later than usual, we plan to release it in March - but belive me, it is worth waiting, something BIG is coming, something a lot of players are waiting for!


[b]UPDATE[/b][list]
[*]Addition of more elements with the existing Tutorial 1, covering character movements during attack phase and description of the new heal system depending on the character types (offensive, support, protective).
[*]Addition of the Tutorial 4, dedicated to the characters Alterated Status.
[*]Addition of the Tutorial 5, dedicated to the Special Circles on Battlefield.
[*]New Heal system depending on the character types: Offensive, Support, Protective.
[*]Resolution 1080p fixed bug on Options menu.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28616363/98cf85ea535a72a9fee74124a2e577dda15a58e1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Prodigy Tactics update | 23 November 2017
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l0CLU3nKmSgcF1Qha/giphy.gif[/img]

Hi everybody,

We are doing a very first update on the Early Access version today with the addition of two multiplayer modes and the implementation of the French version! You can now choose between English or French version in the language settings in the Options on the Main Menu.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bRWBYZj.jpg[/img]

With the multiplayer modes: Against a Friend and Unranked, you can now create a list of your friends and invite them to play against you, or to test your skills against other players with the Unranked mode.
Multiplayer notice: A free account is required to play multiplayer, however the game's official multiplayer servers do not require a unique CD-key to play. 

In addition, Amoa, a new character made her debut on the sands of the third arena, the Citadel of Bak. Both have been added to the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/p6ffOZx.jpg[/img]

A first batch of feedback and bugs you shared with us during this first week has been integrated or fixed. Here is the list of the main issues (don’t worry, we still have a lot more on our to-do list!)

[b]UPDATE[/b][list]
[*]Crash when a player clicks on Surrender option when loading a game / fixed,
[*]Crash when you click on Replay button after a Bastion / fixed,
[*]Crash when using the Bug Reports (ironic isn’t it) / fixed,
[*]Tutorial, bugs in lesson 2 / fixed,
[*]Rota attack animation, vfx and hit on enemies were desynchronized / fixed,
[*]Toboro attack animation, vfx and hit on enemies were desynchronized / fixed,
[*]Siren can now use her second Special Ability “Deadly Breach” / fixed,
[*]Statistics panel at the end of a combat, text on the Play Again and Home buttons / fixed, 
[*]We still need to make a complete revision of the English texts, but we are now using “Circles” instead of “Squares”.[/list]

Thank you for providing our team with your continuing support for Prodigy Tactics. We all look forward to seeing you in game very soon!

notes.title: Multiplayer update on Thursday!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohs7OzLhrdaraQ5OM/giphy.gif[/img]

Hi everyone, good news - the First Big Update (FBU™) is now ready and on its way to Steam on 23 November 2017! In a sneak peek we let out info about additions to the multiplayer mode: new arena - Citadel of Bak, and new playable character - Amoa!

Visit Steam forums to find an introduction to Amoa with her backstory to whet your appetite for this week's update! Let us know what do you think about the newest addition to Prodigy Tactics' family ːsteamhappyː - http://steamcommunity.com/app/626550/discussions/0/3183345176720300520/

-------------------
[h1]Amoa - the Knowledge Bringer[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zmoll3o.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nOjNMIG.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update sneak peek
notes.content:
The Early Access version starts to take shape and we're happy to officially announce the first update coming to Steam next week! To make up for the wait, we're adding alongside [b]the multiplayer mode and arena - a new character: Amoa![/b]

Thank you for your support and incredible feedback, that helps us improve the game! See you on a battlefield!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/g2L7KMs.png[/img]

"Amoa was a bright, disciplined student. She showed so much dedication and enthusiasm that her teacher decided to put her through some very special tests. Though afraid at first, Amoa managed to retain the delicate balance and to succeed the trial. Her training in the martial arts began the next day."

Stay tuned to hear more about Amoa!

notes.title: Contest for all Prodigy fans!
notes.content:
To celebrate our new demo release we prepared something special for you!
So what's the big news?

Contest with a chance to win a key for FULL VERSION of Prodigy after its release!!

To participate you just need to follow three simple steps:

1. Download demo version of Prodigy
2. Record your gameplay and publish it on Youtube
3. Post link to your Youtube video in a comment under this announcement.

THE EARLY BIRD CATCHES THE WORM!
One of the 10 keys will go to THE FASTEST of you!

UPDATE: Good news! Every winner will also receive official Prodigy T-shirt :)
Get ready and be sure you don't miss your chance to win!
